title: Fully Typed Runtime Scanner Operations — Explicit Source Read Failure Judgment
notes: Unrecognized source-read error codes now have a distinct operation-owning judgment and preserve code evidence as StringValue.
The existing upstream blocker contract is reused; unrecognized errors are conservatively mapped to the existing unreadable blocker.
Platform boundary still interprets Node filesystem error codes; primitive reasoning is not claimed to be fully eliminated.
